name: Rheumatism Drops
dosage:
For acute pains, ten drops in some water every 1/2 - 1-2 hours
For chronic pains, 10-15 drops in some water, 2-3 times a day

Safety Information:

Do not exceed the recommended dosage
Read the label carefully before use
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
Keep out of reach of children
